title: Seagrove Beach "Sandpiper Beach House" 126 N Ryan Street
h1: Seagrove Beach "Sandpiper Beach House" 126 N Ryan Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 2 Community pools- Private boardwalk to the beach- Central location to shopping and restaurants- 4 adult bikes- 2 dedicated parking spaces- Pet friendly- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Nestled along an idyllic tree-lined street, steps from private beach access, Sandpiper Beach House is a delightful retreat for 14 guests. This 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom Seagrove Beach home is centrally located near shopping, restaurants, and 2 community pools. Spend sunny days stretched out on the sugar-soft sand of the laid-back beaches while on vacation, explore the various boutiques for the perfect souvenir, and grab lunch at the well-known Café Thirty-A! Guests will love the private boardwalk and multiple outdoor spaces for soaking up the sun.Natural light fills the first level of this charming home, spotlighting the tall ceilings and dark hardwood floors throughout the great room. A plush, oversized sectional and 2 accent armchairs surround the TV in the living room—sink back and unwind with the group after a day of adventure under the sun. In the fully equipped kitchen, high-end appliances and an open floor plan make prepping meals and beach snacks easy. The wooden dining table has 4 chairs and a bench, with 2 more seats at the kitchen island. A spacious guest bedroom decorated in calming coastal colors is on this level. End the day by dining in the open air on the paved back patio with an 8-person table and grill.Head upstairs to discover the beautiful primary bedroom with a king bed, covered porch, and private bathroom. There is also a guest bedroom with a queen bed and a bunk room with 1 full-over-full bed and 1 twin-over-twin bed.An additional sleeping area on the third floor includes a twin daybed and a trundle. Outside, the rooftop deck offers a relaxing location to indulge in an evening cocktail or morning coffee.Let Sandpiper Beach House play host to an unforgettable Seagrove Beach vacation. The private beach walkover is a short stroll away at the end of Chelsea Loop. For public beach access, Eastern Lake is a 6-minute walk. Guests can leisurely explore the area with 4 complimentary adult bikes and parking for 2 vehicles. Book this pet-friendly home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Full-over-Full and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:Additional Sleeping Area: Twin Daybed and Twin Trundle*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs, not to exceed the weight limit of 50lbs for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400 plus tax.*Smoking and vaping in the home is prohibited.
